_comment: A7 item 20(b) / F-A05-3: instrument has zero GraphOutput nodes. Documented as 'not an error - it is silence' (output.md), but previously had no build-time diagnostic anywhere. codegen must still generate (it compiles and returns silence unconditionally via the output_left/output_right zero-init), but warn_graph_output_count must print a non-fatal stderr warning naming the instrument. The golden's emitted .odin is unchanged by this warning - only stderr differs, which the golden compare does not see.
